name: Mac and Cheese With Nekane
source:
"Oh, that must be the microwave mac and cheese!"

Tired? Bored? Well, have a pep talk with Nekane, a ghost that's haunting your house.

[from [url=https://electrinut.itch.io/mac-and-cheese-with-nekane]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“哦，那一定是微波炉奶酪通心粉！”

疲劳的？无聊的？好吧，和在你家里出没的鬼魂Nekane进行一番鼓舞士气的谈话吧。

[来自[url=https://electrinut.itch.io/mac-and-cheese-with-nekane]itch.io[/url]]
